name: intercom-slas
description: Explain why an Intercom SLA was missed and why report percentages disagree. Use pasted chat/ticket events, historical office hours, pause settings and exported rows to explain replacements, late completion and report denominators.

interface.shortDescription: Reconstruct SLA targets and interpret report rows
interface.longDescription: Explain why an Intercom SLA was missed and why report percentages disagree. Two skills analyze supplied chat/ticket events, historical schedules and report rows. Preserve due times after office-hours changes, distinguish reapplication from replacement, and explain fixed breaches, target denominators and historical attribution. Separate phone Speed of Answer rows before comparing chat/ticket rates.
defaultPrompt: Why did this SLA start before the workflow applied it? Here are the events and settings.
Explain these fixed and missed rows, and calculate the target and conversation breach rates.
